bugs_found: compound_interest: division r/n uses integer n without Decimal conversion, but works due to Decimal __truediv__ accepting int; minor: no validation that principal is non-negative
loan_payment: when r==0 returns p/m without converting m to Decimal explicitly (works but inconsistent); no upper bound check on rate
transfer: non-atomic balance update — if second assignment fails after first, source account is debited without credit; no locking for concurrent access
transfer: uses 'is' identity check instead of comparing account ids, so two Account objects with same id would not be detected as self-transfer
apply_fee: does not quantize result to currency precision (e.g. 2 decimals), may return values with excessive precision
fx_convert: does not validate rate is positive; a zero or negative rate in the dict would silently produce wrong results
fx_convert: no quantization of result; precision of input rate string is preserved without rounding policy
General: no use of Decimal context/rounding (ROUND_HALF_EVEN) for monetary calculations, results may differ across environments
General: Account.balance is mutable dataclass field without thread-safety; concurrent transfers can cause race conditions
General: no type hints on function signatures reduces clarity and static analysis
